title: One loop iteration on the counter
statement: For natural numbers $x_0,a,b,t,e,p$, from label $\mathsf{xh}$ with register values $(x_0,a,b,t,e)$ and input position $p$, the program reaches label $\mathsf{th}$ with register values $(0,a,b+x_0,t+x_0,e)$ and the same input position, printing no output, in at most $4x_0+1$ steps. This holds for every output string already printed.
